name: Malaysia Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon and multi-distance race event held 30 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, starting at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and finishing at KLCC.
ai_summary: Malaysia Marathon 2026 takes place on 30 August 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, organized by Malaysia Marathon in partnership with SCORE Experience. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195km, 21km, 10km, and 5km, starting at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and finishing at KLCC. Registration opens 5 May 2026 at 10:00 AM MYT, with Malaysian Open/Veteran pricing ranging from RM65 to RM120.

core_facts.venue: Start Pavilion Bukit Bintang, finish KLCC

pros: Multiple distance options (42km, 21km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Iconic route starting at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and finishing at KLCC
Affordable Malaysian Open/Veteran pricing between RM65–RM120
Organized by an established team with the SCORE Experience partnership
cons: Registration does not open until 5 May 2026, requiring runners to wait to secure a spot

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Malaysia Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Malaysia Marathon 2026 offers four distance categories for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race, catering to both competitive runners and casual participants seeking a shorter distance.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration pricing for the Malaysia Marathon 2026 falls within the Malaysian Open/Veteran rate range of RM65 to RM120, depending on the distance category selected. Registration officially opens on 5 May 2026 at 10:00 AM Malaysian time, so interested runners should plan to sign up promptly.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: The Malaysia Marathon 2026 begins at Pavilion Bukit Bintang and concludes at KLCC, two well-known landmarks in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. This start-to-finish route takes runners through the heart of the city, offering a scenic and centrally located course for all distance categories.

faqs.question: When does registration open for the Malaysia Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Malaysia Marathon 2026 opens on 5 May 2026 at 10:00 AM Malaysian Standard Time (MYT). Runners interested in securing a place in the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, or 5km races should be ready to register at that specific date and time.
